## 🚀 About Me

I'm a **Software Engineer** and Computer Science student at **Simon Fraser University**, graduating in December 2026. I most recently worked at **Apple** on the **VoiceOver accessibility team**, after iOS internships at **Twitch (Amazon)** and **Workday**, and I won the **2025 Apple Swift Student Challenge**. I build across mobile, AI/ML, and accessibility.

My latest focus is **quantitative finance**. I'm building **Microprice**, a market-making research platform with a C++20 limit order book and a kdb+/q tick store, and **NomadFi**, a cross-border personal finance engine. 📈

- 🍎 **Previously:** Software Engineer Intern at **Apple** - VoiceOver Accessibility Team (Summer 2026)
- 🔭 **Previously:** Software Engineer Intern at **Twitch (Amazon)** - Built scalable iOS solutions for 30M+ daily users
- 🏆 **Achievement:** **2025 Apple Swift Student Challenge Winner** with Focus AR project
- 💼 **Previously:** Mobile Engineering Intern (iOS) at **Workday** - iOS Platform Architecture team
- 🎓 **Education:** Computer Science at **Simon Fraser University** (Graduating Dec 2026)
- 📱 **Specialization:** iOS Development, SwiftUI, ARKit, Mobile Platform Engineering
- 📈 **Quant:** Market microstructure, market making, tick data, and distributed backtesting
- 🤖 **Interests:** AI/ML integration in mobile apps, Computer Vision, AR/VR experiences
- 💡 **Focus:** Building user-centric applications that enhance digital experiences
- 📫 **Reach me:** [ariel30190@hotmail.com](mailto:ariel30190@hotmail.com)
